---
name: ui-review
description: Review greenfield LifeOS UI changes for design tokens, responsive behavior, light/dark themes, accessibility, interaction states, and product consistency.
---

# UI Review

- Read the relevant product and design-system documents before reviewing.
- Check semantic tokens, typography, spacing, icons, and shared components.
- Verify 320px overflow, 360/768/1440 layouts, touch-target tiers (24/40/44px per `ui-guidelines.md`), and non-drag
  alternatives.
- Check loading, empty, error/retry, confirmation, and success states.
- Check keyboard order, visible focus, labels, contrast, reduced motion, and
  axe results in light and dark themes.
- Verify timezone formatting and the reminder permission/fallback rules.

Report severity and file/line evidence.
